ios.name: StanceThemeProvider
ios.summary: Applies the Stance theme at the app root, persists the preference and avoids a wrong-theme flash at launch.
accessibility: System mode follows the colour scheme and Increase Contrast
Preference is read before the first frame

ios.name: stanceTheme(_:)
ios.summary: Modifier that applies a Stance appearance (system, light, dark or high contrast) to a view hierarchy.
accessibility: Sets tint, foreground and canvas background from tokens

ios.name: stanceScopedTheme(_:)
ios.summary: Scopes a fixed theme to a subtree, for inverted sections and side-by-side previews.
accessibility: Scoped themes keep the same verified contrast as page themes

ios.name: StanceAppearance
ios.summary: The appearance preference with the same stored values as the web: system, light, dark and high-contrast.
accessibility: Increase Contrast resolves system mode to high contrast

ios.name: StanceCard
ios.summary: A padded surface with optional title, description and footer for grouped, self-contained content.
accessibility: Title is exposed as a heading

ios.name: stanceCard()
ios.summary: Modifier that gives any view the card treatment: padding, surface colour, border and optional elevation.
accessibility: High contrast replaces the shadow with a solid outline

ios.name: stanceSurface()
ios.summary: Modifier that places a view on a token surface level with a corner radius, border and optional shadow.
accessibility: Boundaries meet 3:1 contrast in every theme

ios.name: stanceShadow()
ios.summary: Modifier that adds a token elevation; high contrast draws depth as an outline instead of a blur.
accessibility: Depth never relies on subtle shading in high contrast

ios.name: StanceDivider
ios.summary: A hairline separator in the theme separator colour, horizontal or vertical, hidden from VoiceOver.
accessibility: Decorative: hidden from assistive technology

ios.name: StanceSection
ios.summary: A titled group of content with consistent spacing and an optional caption under the heading.
ios.example: StanceSection("Details", caption: "Shown to your organisation") { Text("Body") }
accessibility: Title is exposed as a heading for rotor navigation

ios.name: StanceContainer
ios.summary: Constrains content to a readable width with page gutters and centres it on iPad.
accessibility: Keeps line length readable at every size class

ios.name: StanceGrid
ios.summary: An adaptive grid that fits as many columns as the minimum item width allows.
accessibility: Reflows to one column at large text sizes

ios.name: StanceIcon
ios.summary: A Stance icon drawn natively from the shared icon geometry; decorative unless a label is given.
accessibility: Hidden from VoiceOver without a label
Scales with Dynamic Type

ios.name: stanceText(_:)
ios.summary: Modifier that applies a semantic Stance text style which scales with Dynamic Type and Bold Text.
accessibility: Scales through the largest accessibility sizes
Never below 12pt at the default size

ios.name: StanceButton
ios.summary: A button with six variants, three sizes, icons, a pill shape and a loading state that blocks repeat taps.
accessibility: 44pt minimum target at every size
Loading is announced as “In progress”

ios.name: StanceButtonStyle
ios.summary: The Stance button style for any Button, Menu label or NavigationLink: .buttonStyle(.stance(.primary)).
accessibility: Press feedback respects Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceIconButton
ios.summary: An icon-only button that requires an accessibility label and keeps a 44pt touch target.
accessibility: Label is required and used by VoiceOver and Voice Control
Pointer hover effect on iPad

ios.name: StanceButtonGroup
ios.summary: Lays related buttons out in a row and stacks them vertically at accessibility text sizes.
accessibility: Reflows instead of truncating at large text sizes

ios.name: StanceMenu
ios.summary: The native Menu with a Stance button as its trigger, for short lists of actions.
accessibility: System menu behaviour, VoiceOver and keyboard support

ios.name: StanceFormField
ios.summary: Wires a visible label, helper text and an announced error message to a single control.
accessibility: Label becomes the control’s accessibility label
Errors are announced when they appear

ios.name: StanceTextField
ios.summary: A labelled single-line text field with helper text, error state, required marker and leading icon.
ios.example: StanceTextField("Template name", text: $text, helper: "Visible to your organisation", isRequired: true)
accessibility: Visible label matches the accessibility label for Voice Control
Error replaces the helper in the hint

ios.name: StanceSecureField
ios.summary: A password field with a show and hide control that keeps a 44pt target.
accessibility: Toggle is labelled Show password or Hide password

ios.name: StanceTextEditor
ios.summary: A labelled multi-line editor with an optional live character count.
accessibility: Character count is part of the field hint

ios.name: StanceSearchField
ios.summary: An inline search field with a clear button; use the system searchable modifier for screen-level search.
accessibility: Clear button is labelled and reachable

ios.name: StancePicker
ios.summary: A labelled native Picker shown as a menu inside Stance field chrome.
accessibility: Selected value is exposed as the accessibility value

ios.name: StanceCheckbox
ios.summary: A checkbox with a label and description; iOS has no system checkbox, so it is exposed as a toggle.
ios.example: StanceCheckbox("Apply to new members", description: "Added later", isOn: $isOn)
accessibility: Whole row is the 44pt target
Announces Checked or Not checked

ios.name: StanceRadioGroup
ios.summary: A group of mutually exclusive options visible at once, with optional descriptions.
accessibility: Selected option carries the selected trait
Group is labelled by its title

ios.name: StanceToggleStyle
ios.summary: Stance colours for the native Toggle switch, keeping system behaviour and accessibility.
accessibility: Native switch semantics and haptics

ios.name: StanceSlider
ios.summary: A labelled native Slider that reports a formatted value visually and to VoiceOver.
accessibility: Adjustable trait with a readable value

ios.name: StanceDatePicker
ios.summary: A labelled native DatePicker for dates or times in Stance colours.
accessibility: System picker with full VoiceOver and keyboard support

ios.name: StanceAdaptiveNavigation
ios.summary: Top-level navigation that is a tab bar in compact width and a sidebar in regular width.
ios.example: StanceAdaptiveNavigation("Stance", selection: $role, destinations: [.init(id: "admin", title: "Home", systemImage: "house")]) { _ in Text("Home") }
accessibility: System bars keep their materials, including Liquid Glass on iOS 26

ios.name: stanceNavigationChrome()
ios.summary: Modifier that themes navigation and tab bar tint while leaving system bar materials untouched.
accessibility: Bar content stays legible in all three themes

ios.name: StanceStepper
ios.summary: Shows progress through a multi-step task with completed, current and upcoming steps.
accessibility: Each step reads “Step x of y” with its state

ios.name: StancePageIndicator
ios.summary: Dots that show the position in a short paged sequence.
accessibility: Read as “Page 2 of 4”
Animation respects Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceBadge
ios.summary: A short status label in a neutral, info, success, warning or danger tone, always with text.
accessibility: Never colour alone
Outlined in high contrast

ios.name: StanceTag
ios.summary: A keyword label with an optional remove button labelled with the tag name.
accessibility: Remove button reads “Remove Sales”

ios.name: StanceAvatar
ios.summary: A person or organisation shown as an image or initials, in three sizes.
accessibility: Name is the accessibility label

ios.name: StanceAvatarGroup
ios.summary: Overlapping avatars with a +N overflow, read as one summary by VoiceOver.
accessibility: Reads names followed by “and N more”

ios.name: StanceProgressView
ios.summary: Linear or circular progress in Stance colours, determinate or indeterminate.
accessibility: Label and percentage are exposed to VoiceOver

ios.name: StanceSkeleton
ios.summary: A placeholder for loading content in text, circle or rectangle shapes; static under Reduce Motion.
accessibility: Hidden from VoiceOver

ios.name: StanceEmptyState
ios.summary: Explains an empty screen or list and offers the next action.
ios.example: StanceEmptyState(title: "No templates yet", message: "Create your first signature template.") { StanceButton("New template") {} }
accessibility: Title is a heading

ios.name: StanceTimeline
ios.summary: A vertical sequence of events with a title, detail, time and tone.
ios.example: StanceTimeline([.init(id: "1", title: "Deployed", detail: "48 mailboxes", time: "09:41", tone: .success)])
accessibility: Each event is one combined element

ios.name: StanceStatCard
ios.summary: A key figure with a label and a change that is described in words for VoiceOver.
accessibility: Reads “up 12% from last month”, not just an arrow

ios.name: StanceDescriptionList
ios.summary: Term and detail pairs that stack vertically at accessibility text sizes.
accessibility: Each pair is read together

ios.name: StanceListRow
ios.summary: A list row with leading content, title, subtitle and trailing accessory for List and NavigationLink.
accessibility: 44pt minimum row height

ios.name: stanceListStyle()
ios.summary: Modifiers that put List and Form on the Stance canvas with themed rows and separators.
accessibility: Keeps native list behaviour, swipe actions and editing

ios.name: StanceDisclosureGroupStyle
ios.summary: Stance styling for the native DisclosureGroup with a 44pt header.
accessibility: Announces Expanded or Collapsed

ios.name: StanceInlineAlert
ios.summary: An inline status message with a tone icon, title, message and optional actions.
ios.example: StanceInlineAlert("Relay offline", message: "Deployments will resume.", tone: .warning)
accessibility: Warning and danger tones are announced when shown

ios.name: StanceBanner
ios.summary: A full-width announcement with an optional action and dismiss button.
ios.example: StanceBanner("Maintenance on Sunday", actionTitle: "Details", action: {}, onDismiss: {})
accessibility: Dismiss button is labelled and 44pt

ios.name: StanceToastCenter
ios.summary: Queues transient messages, shows one at a time and announces each to VoiceOver.
accessibility: Announced without moving focus
Manual dismiss always available

ios.name: StanceLoadingState
ios.summary: A centred progress indicator with a message for loading screens and regions.
accessibility: Indicator and message are one element

ios.name: StanceErrorState
ios.summary: Explains a failure in plain language and offers a retry action.
ios.example: StanceErrorState(message: "We could not load your templates.") {}
accessibility: Title is a heading; retry is a labelled button

ios.name: stanceSheet()
ios.summary: Presents the native sheet with a title bar, detents and themed content.
accessibility: System sheet gestures, grabber and focus handling

ios.name: stanceAlert()
ios.summary: Presents the system alert from a typed confirmation, with a destructive option.
accessibility: System alert semantics and focus

ios.name: stanceConfirmationDialog()
ios.summary: Presents the system confirmation dialog: an action sheet on iPhone and a popover on iPad.
accessibility: Cancel is always available

ios.name: StanceFilterBar
ios.summary: A horizontally scrolling row of selectable filter chips with a clear-all action.
accessibility: Selected chips carry the selected trait and a check mark

ios.name: StanceSearchableList
ios.summary: A list with native search that filters as you type and announces the result count.
accessibility: Result count is announced
Empty state explains what to try

ios.name: StanceCalendar
ios.summary: A month calendar built on the native graphical DatePicker in Stance colours.
accessibility: Full system calendar accessibility

ios.name: StanceSignatureCanvas
ios.summary: A canvas for drawing a signature with a finger or Apple Pencil, with undo, clear and an alternative slot.
ios.example: StanceSignatureCanvas(signature: $signature) { StanceTextField("Or type your name", text: $text) }
accessibility: Direct-touch trait for VoiceOver
Offer the typed alternative for people who cannot draw

ios.name: StanceAttachmentPicker
ios.summary: Buttons that open the system photo picker and file importer without requesting library permission.
accessibility: System pickers are fully accessible

ios.name: StanceDocumentPreview
ios.summary: Previews a local PDF, image or document with the system Quick Look viewer (iOS only).
accessibility: Quick Look provides zoom, VoiceOver and text selection

ios.name: stanceTouchTarget()
ios.summary: Modifier that guarantees the 44 by 44 point minimum interactive target without changing visual size.
accessibility: Apple HIG minimum target

ios.name: StanceUIKit
ios.summary: UIKit access to Stance: dynamic UIColor roles, Dynamic Type UIFonts and a themed hosting controller.
accessibility: Dynamic colours follow dark mode and Increase Contrast

ios.name: StanceHaptics
ios.summary: Haptic feedback helpers for selection, success, warning and error; no-ops where unavailable.
accessibility: Haptics supplement, never replace, visible feedback

ios.name: StanceRangeSlider
ios.summary: Two thumbs on one track choose a lower and an upper value, each adjustable on its own with VoiceOver.
accessibility: Each thumb is a separate adjustable element named by the label and its role
Thumbs mirror in right to left layouts like the system slider
The range is spoken as words, for example 1,000 to 5,000

ios.name: StancePinField
ios.summary: Boxes for a short verification code over one real text field, so autofill from Messages and paste fill every box.
accessibility: VoiceOver reads one text field, not separate boxes
Masked codes report how many characters are entered instead of the characters
The code reads left to right in every language

ios.name: StanceNumberField
ios.summary: A number typed in local format or nudged with the system stepper, kept inside its bounds and rounded on commit.
ios.example: StanceNumberField("Licence seats", value: $value, min: 1, max: 500, suffix: "seats")
accessibility: The system stepper adjusts with VoiceOver swipes
Prefix and suffix are read with the value
Numbers are written and read in the conventions of the locale

ios.name: StanceCombobox
ios.summary: Opens a searchable system list in a sheet or popover and picks one value, such as a template owner.
ios.example: StanceCombobox("Template owner", selection: $selection, options: [.init("priya", label: "Priya Nair", detail: "Admin"), .init("lukas", label: "Lukas Brenner", detail: "Sales")])
accessibility: The field reads its label and the chosen value
The chosen row carries the selected trait
Result counts are announced while searching

ios.name: StanceMultiSelect
ios.summary: Picks several values from a searchable list and shows each choice below the field as a removable tag.
accessibility: The field reads every chosen value as a list
Each tag has a remove button named after its value
Rows report their selected state

ios.name: StanceCheckboxGroup
ios.summary: A short list of checkboxes under one heading, with helper or error text and an optional select all.
ios.example: StanceCheckboxGroup("Notify by", selection: $filters, options: [.init("email", label: "Email"), .init("push", label: "Push")], showsSelectAll: true)
accessibility: The heading names the group as VoiceOver enters it
Select all reports checked, not checked or partly checked
Errors are announced when they appear

ios.name: StanceDateRangePicker
ios.summary: A start and an end date from two system date pickers, with presets and the span summarised in words.
accessibility: Each picker is named Start or End
The end date can never fall before the start date
The summary reads the range and its length as one line

ios.name: StanceTimePicker
ios.summary: A time of day from the system date picker, with the hour cycle and digits following the locale.
accessibility: The system picker reads the label and the time
Compact and wheel styles both keep a 44pt target

ios.name: StanceInlineEdit
ios.summary: Text that becomes a text field when tapped. Return saves, cancel or Escape restores the earlier value.
accessibility: The row reads its label and value with a hint that it can be edited
Save and cancel are labelled buttons with 44pt targets
Validation errors are announced

ios.name: StanceDataTable
ios.summary: Sortable rows with selection: the system Table on iPad and labelled cards on iPhone, where columns have no room.
accessibility: Compact cards read every column name with its value
Selected rows carry the selected trait
Sort direction is spoken on the sort menu

ios.name: StancePagination
ios.summary: Previous and next buttons with a page summary, and a steady row of page numbers when the width allows.
accessibility: The new page is announced after each move
The current page carries the selected trait
Labels give way to icons at accessibility text sizes

ios.name: StanceTreeView
ios.summary: Nested folders or teams in a List, with expansion you control, selection and level information for VoiceOver.
ios.example: StanceTreeView(nodes: [StanceTreeNode(id: "templates", title: "Templates", children: [StanceTreeNode(id: "sales", title: "Sales signature")])], expanded: .constant(["templates"]), selection: $selection)
accessibility: Each row reads its level, position and expanded state
Expand and collapse are VoiceOver actions
Chevrons point the right way in right to left layouts

ios.name: StanceSortableList
ios.summary: A List people reorder by dragging the system handles or with Move up and Move down actions in VoiceOver.
ios.example: StanceSortableList("Approval steps", items: .constant([ComponentExamples.Named(name: "Legal"), ComponentExamples.Named(name: "Finance")]), itemLabel: \.name) { Text($0.name) }
accessibility: Move up and Move down actions need no drag
Each move is announced with the new position
Rows read their position in the list

ios.name: StanceChart
ios.summary: Line, bar or area chart on Swift Charts in ink tones, with a spoken summary, Audio Graphs and a table view.
accessibility: VoiceOver reads a summary with the highest and lowest values
Audio Graphs through an accessibility chart descriptor
Series differ by symbol and dash, not colour alone

ios.name: StanceRichText
ios.summary: Turns Markdown into headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and code, set in the Stance type scale.
ios.example: StanceRichText(markdown: "## Rollout\nSignatures deploy **after** the next sync.")
accessibility: Headings carry the header trait for the rotor
Links use the link colour and an underline
Text scales with Dynamic Type

ios.name: StanceCodeBlock
ios.summary: Monospaced code that scrolls sideways, with optional line numbers and a copy button that confirms with a tick.
accessibility: Line numbers are hidden from VoiceOver
Copying is announced and confirmed with a haptic
Code stays left to right in right to left layouts

ios.name: StanceProgressCircle
ios.summary: A ring that fills with progress and shows the percentage inside, built on the system ProgressView.
accessibility: Read as progress with its label and percentage
Every size keeps a 44pt frame
A success haptic plays when it completes

ios.name: StanceAccordion
ios.summary: Stacks collapsible sections on DisclosureGroup, with one or many open at a time and an optional card for each.
ios.example: StanceAccordion([StanceAccordionSection(id: "billing", title: "Billing")], expanded: $filters, mode: .single) { _ in Text("Invoices go out on the first of the month.") }
accessibility: Each title is a header and a button that reports expanded or collapsed
Disabled sections cannot be toggled
Opening and closing follow Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceTabs
ios.summary: Switches views within one screen, as the system segmented control or a scrolling underline strip with counts.
ios.example: StanceTabs([StanceTab(id: "admin", title: "Details"), StanceTab(id: "member", title: "Activity", badge: 3)], selection: $role) { Text($0) }
accessibility: Each tab reads its position, such as Tab 2 of 4
The selected tab carries the selected trait
The strip scrolls the selected tab into view

ios.name: StanceCopyButton
ios.summary: Puts text on the pasteboard, then briefly shows a tick with a spoken confirmation and a success haptic.
accessibility: Copied is announced without moving focus
Icon only buttons keep Copy as their name
The confirmation reverts on its own after a moment

ios.name: StanceSplitButton
ios.summary: Pairs a main action with a menu of related ones, using the system menu with a primary action plus a chevron.
accessibility: VoiceOver hears the action and a separate More options button
A hint explains touch and hold
Both segments keep a 44pt target

ios.name: StanceToggleButton
ios.summary: A button that stays pressed while its option is on, drawn from the native Toggle with a filled selected look.
accessibility: The on state carries the selected trait
On is shown by fill, border and weight, not colour alone
A selection tick plays when it changes

ios.name: StanceToggleButtonGroup
ios.summary: Related toggle buttons for one setting, as a single or multiple choice, wrapping onto new lines at large sizes.
ios.example: StanceToggleButtonGroup("Channels", selection: $filters, options: [StanceToggleOption("email", title: "Email"), StanceToggleOption("sms", title: "SMS")])
accessibility: The group is named by its label
Each option reports whether it is selected
Buttons reflow instead of truncating

ios.name: StanceChip
ios.summary: A small rounded value people can tap or remove, such as a recipient or a condition already applied.
accessibility: The remove button is named after the value
Remove keeps a 44pt touch area around a small icon
A chip without an action reads as plain text

ios.name: StanceFilterChip
ios.summary: An on or off chip for a row of filters, with a tick and an optional match count once applied.
accessibility: The applied state carries the selected trait
The tick means status is never shown by colour alone
A selection tick plays when it changes

ios.name: StanceNotificationRow
ios.summary: One notice with its time and unread dot, plus swipe and VoiceOver actions to mark it read or delete it.
ios.example: List { StanceNotificationRow("Deployment finished", message: "48 mailboxes updated", time: "2 min ago", isUnread: true, onDelete: {}) }
accessibility: Unread is spoken before the title
Swipe actions are also VoiceOver custom actions
Text reflows at accessibility sizes

ios.name: StanceThread
ios.summary: The scrolling container for a conversation. Follows the latest message while the reader is at the bottom and releases when they scroll up.
accessibility: A labelled container for the conversation
Never moves the reader while they are scrolled up
Scroll to latest button keeps a 44pt target

ios.name: StanceMessage
ios.summary: One turn in a conversation from the user, the assistant or the system, with slots for actions and a footer.
ios.example: StanceMessage(role: .assistant, status: .streaming, author: "Assistant") { StanceStreamingText(text, isStreaming: true) }
accessibility: Named by author and time
Status is exposed as a value and marked as updating while streaming
The assistant is identified by the sparkle and its name, never by colour

ios.name: StanceMessageGroup
ios.summary: Runs of messages from one author gathered under a single avatar and name, so the thread reads calmly.
accessibility: The group is named by its author
The avatar is decorative

ios.name: StanceMessageActions
ios.summary: Copy, retry, edit and rating buttons in a row beneath a message, each with a clear VoiceOver name.
ios.example: StanceMessageActions(rating: rating, onCopy: {}, onRetry: {}, onRate: { rating = $0 })
accessibility: Every button has a name and a 44pt target
Rating buttons are toggles with a selected state
Copy confirms with a polite announcement
Wraps onto more lines at large text sizes

ios.name: StanceBranchSwitcher
ios.summary: Moves between the alternative versions of a message that an edit or a retry produced.
accessibility: Previous and next buttons are named and disabled at the ends
The position is read as "Version 2 of 3" and announced when it changes
Chevrons mirror in right to left layouts

ios.name: StanceScrollToLatest
ios.summary: A floating button that shows up once the reader scrolls away from the newest message and jumps back.
accessibility: Named "Scroll to latest" with the unread count as its value
44pt target
Fades without movement under Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceConversationList
ios.summary: A list of past conversations grouped by date, with selection, rename, pin and delete.
ios.example: StanceConversationList([StanceConversation(id: "1", title: "Budget review", updatedAt: date)], selection: $selection, onDelete: { _ in })
accessibility: The open conversation has the selected trait
Rename, pin and delete are swipe actions and context menu items
Section headers name each date group

ios.name: StanceThreadEmptyState
ios.summary: The first screen of a fresh conversation, with a greeting and a few starter prompts to tap.
ios.example: StanceThreadEmptyState(description: "Ask about your documents.", starters: [StanceStarter(id: "1", label: "Summarise a file")]) { _ in }
accessibility: The greeting is a heading
Starters are full width buttons with 44pt targets

ios.name: StancePromptComposer
ios.summary: The message input. A text field that grows with its content, with slots for attachments, tools and the send or stop button.
accessibility: A labelled group with a labelled field
Send is disabled when the draft is empty
While a response is generated the same button is named Stop
Controls move below the field at accessibility text sizes

ios.name: StanceAttachmentTray
ios.summary: The attachments on a draft or a sent message: files and images with progress, errors and remove.
accessibility: Each remove button names its file
Upload errors are announced and shown with an icon and text
Becomes a column at accessibility text sizes

ios.name: StanceMentionPicker
ios.summary: A filterable list that opens from a trigger character to reference files, people or tools.
ios.example: StanceMentionPicker(isPresented: $isPresented, query: text, items: [StanceSuggestion(id: "1", label: "Budget.xlsx")]) { _ in }
accessibility: A labelled list above the composer; focus stays in the field
Escape and the VoiceOver escape gesture close it
The number of matches is announced

ios.name: StanceSlashCommandMenu
ios.summary: A command list that opens when the draft starts with a slash.
ios.example: StanceSlashCommandMenu(isPresented: $isPresented, query: text, commands: [StanceSlashCommand(id: "1", name: "summarise")]) { _ in }
accessibility: Same list pattern as the mention picker
Escape and the VoiceOver escape gesture close it

ios.name: StanceModelPicker
ios.summary: A system menu for choosing the model behind the next message, with a short line and capability badges.
accessibility: The system menu, with its own tick and VoiceOver behaviour
The chosen model is the value

ios.name: StanceContextChips
ios.summary: Shows what the assistant can see for this message, such as files, pages or selections, each removable.
ios.example: StanceContextChips([StanceContextItem(id: "1", label: "budget.xlsx", icon: .file, kind: "File")], onRemove: { _ in }, onAdd: {})
accessibility: Each remove button names its item
The kind is read before the label
Chips wrap instead of truncating the row

ios.name: StanceVoiceInputButton
ios.summary: A microphone button with idle, listening and processing states and a level indicator.
accessibility: A toggle button with the state as its value
State changes are announced
The level ring is still under Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceStopButton
ios.summary: Stops a response that is being generated.
accessibility: Named "Stop"
44pt target at every size

ios.name: StanceTokenBudgetMeter
ios.summary: A compact meter of how much of the context or message limit is used, with a warning near the limit.
accessibility: One element with the value in words
The warning is an icon and text, never colour alone
Crossing the warning threshold and the limit is announced once each

ios.name: StanceStreamingText
ios.summary: Reveals text as it arrives at a steady cadence with an optional caret, without reflowing what is already on screen.
accessibility: VoiceOver gets the text once, when it is complete, never token by token
Text appears at once under Reduce Motion
Never takes focus

ios.name: StanceThinkingIndicator
ios.summary: Shows that the assistant is working before any text arrives, with an optional label and elapsed time.
accessibility: The label is announced once when it appears
A still sparkle with the label under Reduce Motion
Elapsed time is the value

ios.name: StanceReasoningDisclosure
ios.summary: A collapsible block for the assistant's reasoning. Open while thinking, collapsed to a summary when done.
accessibility: A button with its expanded state
The summary reads, for example, "Thought for 12 seconds"

ios.name: StanceShimmerText
ios.summary: A label with a slow sweep of light for work in progress, such as searching, and still under Reduce Motion.
accessibility: Plain text to assistive technology
No animation under Reduce Motion
The sweep follows the reading direction

ios.name: StanceGenerationProgress
ios.summary: Progress for longer generations such as images or documents: determinate or indeterminate, with a stage label.
accessibility: One element with the percentage and stage as its value
Stage changes are announced politely
A success haptic when it completes

ios.name: StanceStreamingSkeleton
ios.summary: Placeholder lines for a response that has been requested and has not started.
accessibility: One element named "Loading response"
Still under Reduce Motion

ios.name: StanceInterruptedState
ios.summary: Flags a response that stopped or failed part way through and offers retry and continue.
accessibility: Errors and lost connections are announced as alerts; stopped and limit are polite
The reason is an icon and words, never colour alone

ios.name: StanceCitationChip
ios.summary: An inline numbered marker that links a claim to its source and previews it on tap.
ios.example: StanceCitationChip(index: 2, source: StanceSource(id: "1", title: "Quarterly report", url: URL(string: "https://example.com")))
accessibility: Named "Source 2: title"
The preview is a popover on iPad and a sheet on iPhone
44pt target around a small mark

ios.name: StanceSourceList
ios.summary: The sources behind an answer, as a compact row that expands to a full list.
accessibility: The compact row is a button with its expanded state
Each row is a link named by number, title and site

ios.name: StanceSourcePreview
ios.summary: A card for one source: title, site, snippet and a link to open it.
ios.example: StanceSourcePreview(StanceSource(id: "1", title: "Quarterly report", domain: "example.com", snippet: "Revenue grew 12%."))
accessibility: The open control is a link
Text wraps instead of truncating at regular size

ios.name: StanceConfidenceBadge

ios.name: StanceAIGeneratedLabel

ios.name: StanceDisclaimerNote

accessibility: Muted text still meets contrast in every theme
The icon is decorative

ios.name: StanceFeedbackBar

ios.name: StanceReportDialog

ios.name: StanceSensitiveContentGate

android.name: StanceTheme

android.name: StanceSurface
android.summary: A themed container with token elevation that becomes a solid outline in high contrast.

android.name: StanceCard

android.name: StanceDivider

android.name: StanceScaffold

accessibility: Content receives system bar, cutout and keyboard insets as padding.

android.name: StanceAdaptiveGrid
android.summary: A lazy grid that fits as many columns as the window allows on phones, tablets and foldables.
accessibility: Reading order follows the grid from start to end.

android.name: StanceIcon
android.summary: Draws one of the 99 Stance icons, tinted with the current content colour.
accessibility: Pass null as the description for decorative icons.

android.name: stanceFocusRing
android.summary: A modifier that draws the Stance focus ring while an element has keyboard or D-pad focus.
accessibility: The ring is 2dp, or 3dp in high contrast.

android.name: StanceButton

android.name: StanceIconButton

The content description is required.

android.name: StanceFloatingActionButton

android.name: StanceButtonGroup

var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceButtonGroup(listOf("Day", "Week", "Month"), selected, onSelect = { selected = it })
accessibility: Announced as a radio group with the selected segment.

android.name: StanceSplitButton
android.summary: A primary action paired with a menu of related actions.

StanceSplitButton(
    text = "Save",

    menuItems = listOf(StanceMenuItem("Save as draft", onClick = {}), StanceMenuItem("Save and deploy", onClick = {})),
    menuDescription = "More save options",
)
accessibility: The menu button has its own accessible name.

android.name: StanceDropdownMenu
android.summary: A menu of actions with icons, groups, disabled and destructive items.
accessibility: Dismisses on back, outside taps and Escape.

android.name: StanceFormField
android.summary: Lays out a label, a control, helper text and an announced error message.
accessibility: Errors are a polite live region and include an icon.
The required marker is read as required.

android.name: StanceTextField
android.summary: A text input with a label above it, helper text, error state, prefix and suffix.
android.example:
var name by remember { mutableStateOf("Sales team signature") }
StanceTextField(name, { name = it }, label = "Template name", helper = "Visible to your organisation.", required = true)
accessibility: The label is the accessible name.
An error marks the field invalid and is announced.

android.name: StancePasswordField
android.summary: A password input with a button to show or hide the value.
android.example:
var password by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
StancePasswordField(password, { password = it }, label = "Password")

android.name: StanceSearchBar
android.summary: A search field with a clear button and a search keyboard action.
android.example:
var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
StanceSearchBar(query, { query = it }, placeholder = "Search templates")
accessibility: The clear button has an accessible name.

android.name: StanceCheckbox
android.summary: A checkbox with a label and description, including an indeterminate state.
android.example:
var checked by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceCheckbox("Send me a copy", checked, { checked = it }, description = "A PDF is emailed after signing.")
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The row is one toggle announced with its label and state.

android.name: StanceRadioGroup
android.summary: A labelled set of mutually exclusive options with optional descriptions.
android.example:
var role by remember { mutableStateOf("editor") }
StanceRadioGroup(
    label = "Role",
    options = listOf(StanceRadioOption("viewer", "Viewer"), StanceRadioOption("editor", "Editor", "Can change templates")),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Announced as a group, with each option as a radio button.

android.name: StanceSwitch
android.summary: A switch with its label for settings that apply immediately.
android.example:
var enabled by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceSwitch("Apply to new members automatically", enabled, { enabled = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Announced as a switch with On or Off.

android.name: StanceSlider
android.summary: Picks a number from a range, with a visible label and value.
android.example:
var value by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(40f) }
StanceSlider("Rollout", value, { value = it }, valueRange = 0f..100f, valueText = "${value.toInt()}%")

The value text is announced.

android.name: StanceRangeSlider
android.summary: Picks a lower and an upper bound from a range using two thumbs.
android.example:
var range by remember { mutableStateOf(20f..80f) }
StanceRangeSlider("Team size", range, { range = it }, valueRange = 0f..100f, valueText = "${range.start.toInt()} to ${range.endInclusive.toInt()}")

android.name: StanceSelect
android.summary: Chooses one value from a list using the platform exposed dropdown menu.
android.example:
var role by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("admin") }
StanceSelect(
    label = "Role",
    options = listOf(StanceSelectOption("admin", "Administrator"), StanceSelectOption("member", "Member")),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
)
accessibility: The field is named by its label and announces the selected value.

android.name: StanceDatePicker
android.summary: A date field that opens the Material date picker in a dialog.
android.example:
var date by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
StanceDatePicker("Signing deadline", date, onDateSelected = { date = it })
accessibility: Uses the platform picker, including its keyboard input mode.

android.name: StanceDateRangePicker
android.summary: A field for a start and end date using the Material range picker.
accessibility: Uses the platform picker semantics.

android.name: StanceTimePicker
android.summary: A time field that opens the Material time picker, in 12 or 24 hour format.
android.example:
var time by remember { mutableStateOf<Pair<Int, Int>?>(9 to 30) }
StanceTimePicker("Reminder", time?.first, time?.second, onTimeSelected = { h, m -> time = h to m })
accessibility: Uses the platform picker semantics.

android.name: StanceFilterChip

android.example:
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceFilterChip("Signed", selected, onClick = { selected = !selected })

android.name: StanceInputChip
android.summary: A removable chip for something a person entered, such as a recipient.
android.example: StanceInputChip("Priya Nair", onRemove = {}, removeDescription = "Remove Priya Nair")
accessibility: The remove action has a descriptive label.

android.name: StanceNavigationBar
android.summary: Bottom navigation for three to five destinations on compact screens.
android.example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceNavigationBar(destinations, selected, onSelect = { selected = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The selected destination is announced.

android.name: StanceNavigationRail
android.summary: Side navigation for medium-width windows such as tablets in portrait.
android.example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceNavigationRail(destinations, selected, onSelect = { selected = it }, modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSpacing.space24 * 3))
accessibility: The selected destination is announced.

android.name: StanceNavigationDrawer

accessibility: The selected item is filled and announced as selected.

android.name: StanceAdaptiveNavigation
android.summary: Navigation that switches between bar, rail and drawer by window width.
accessibility: Order and selection are kept across layouts.

android.name: StanceTopAppBar
android.summary: The bar at the top of a screen with a title, navigation and actions.
accessibility: The title is a heading.
The back button has an accessible name.

android.name: StanceTabs
android.summary: Switches between views of the same context, fixed or scrollable.

var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceTabs(listOf("Details", "Rollout", "History"), selected, onSelect = { selected = it })

android.name: StancePagerIndicator

android.name: StanceStepper

android.name: StanceListItem

)

android.name: StanceBadge

android.name: StanceTag

android.name: StanceAvatar

android.name: StanceAvatarGroup

android.name: StanceEmptyState

android.name: StanceTimeline

android.name: StanceStatCard

android.name: StanceSnackbarHost

android.name: StanceTooltip

android.name: StanceBanner

android.name: StanceButtonView

android.name: StanceThread

android.name: StanceMessage

android.name: StanceMessageGroup

android.name: StanceMessageActions

android.name: StanceBranchSwitcher

var index by remember { mutableIntStateOf(1) }
StanceBranchSwitcher(count = 3, index = index, onIndexChange = { index = it })

android.name: StanceScrollToLatest

android.name: StanceConversationList

android.name: StancePromptComposer

android.name: StanceAttachmentTray

android.name: StanceMentionPicker

android.name: StanceSlashCommandMenu

android.name: StanceModelPicker

StanceModelPicker(models = sampleModels, selectedId = model, onSelect = { model = it.id })

android.name: StanceContextChips
android.summary: Shows what the assistant can see for this message, such as files or pages, each removable.

android.name: StanceVoiceInputButton

android.name: StanceStopButton

android.name: StanceTokenBudgetMeter

android.name: StanceThinkingIndicator

android.name: StanceReasoningDisclosure

android.name: StanceStreamingSkeleton
android.summary: Placeholder lines, card or image for a response that has been requested and has not started.
android.example: StanceStreamingSkeleton(lines = 3)
accessibility: Read as one loading status.
The pulse stops when animations are off.

android.name: StanceInterruptedState
android.summary: Marks a response that was stopped or failed part way, with retry and continue.
android.example:
StanceInterruptedState(
    reason = StanceInterruptedReason.Network,
    description = "The answer stopped part way. Your draft is safe.",
    onRetry = { println("Retry") },
    onContinue = { println("Continue") },
)
accessibility: Errors and lost connections are alerts.
Stopped and limit are polite statuses.

android.name: StanceCitationChip
android.summary: A numbered marker that links a claim to its source and previews it in a bottom sheet.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A button named, for example, Source 2 and the title.
The preview is reachable by touch, keyboard and screen reader.

android.name: StanceSourceList
android.summary: The sources behind an answer, as a compact row of chips that expands to a full list.
android.example: StanceSourceList(sources = sampleSources, max = 2, onSourceOpen = { println("Open ${it.title}") })
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Each chip is named by its source title.

android.name: StanceSourcePreview
android.summary: A card for one source: site, title, snippet and a link to open it.
android.example: StanceSourcePreview(source = sampleSources[0], onOpen = { println("Open source") })
accessibility: The link is a button with a visible label.

android.name: StanceConfidenceBadge
android.summary: States how sure the system is in words with a distinct icon, never colour alone.
accessibility: Read as the label and its description together.

android.name: StanceAIGeneratedLabel
android.summary: Marks content as generated, assisted or edited by AI, with the sparkle icon and the model name.
accessibility: Read as one phrase.

android.name: StanceDisclaimerNote
android.summary: Small print beneath the composer or a reply, for example a reminder to verify key facts.
android.example: StanceDisclaimerNote("Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.")
accessibility: Read as plain text.

android.name: StanceFeedbackBar
android.summary: Thumbs up or down, followed by optional reasons and a comment, then a thank you.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Rating buttons are toggles.
Reasons are a labelled group.
The thank you is announced.

android.name: StanceReportDialog
android.summary: A bottom sheet to report a response with a category and details.
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Categories are a radio group.
Stays open and busy while the report is sent.

android.name: StanceSensitiveContentGate
android.summary: Hides content behind a notice until the reader chooses to see it.
accessibility: Hidden content is absent from the accessibility tree.
Focus moves to the content on reveal.

android.name: StanceAccordion
android.summary: Stacked section headings that open to reveal their content, one at a time or several together.
android.example:
StanceAccordion(
    items = listOf(
        StanceAccordionItem("rollout", "Rollout") { Text("Signatures deploy to every mailbox tonight.") },
        StanceAccordionItem("history", "Version history") { Text("Three published versions.") },
    ),
    initiallyExpanded = setOf("rollout"),
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Each header is a heading that reports Expanded or Collapsed.
Opens at once when animations are off.

android.name: StanceCollapsible
android.summary: A single heading that shows or hides the content beneath it, for optional detail.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The header has expand and collapse actions and reports its state.

android.name: StanceCalendar
android.summary: An inline month grid for picking a day, built on the Material date picker without a dialog.
android.example:
var day by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
StanceCalendar(selectedDateMillis = day, onDateSelected = { day = it })
accessibility: Each day is a button named by its full date.
Days outside the allowed range are disabled.

android.name: StanceChart
android.summary: Line, bar and area charts drawn on Canvas, with a spoken summary and a stop for each category.
android.example:
StanceChart(
    title = "Signatures sent",
    categories = listOf("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"),
    series = listOf(
        StanceChartSeries("Sent", listOf(12f, 30f, 26f, 48f)),
        StanceChartSeries("Opened", listOf(8f, 21f, 20f, 39f)),
    ),
)
accessibility: The chart is read as one summary, then one stop per category with every value.
Lines differ by dash pattern as well as colour.

android.name: StanceCheckboxGroup
android.summary: A labelled set of checkboxes for choosing several options, with an optional select all.
android.example:
var channels by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf("email")) }
StanceCheckboxGroup(
    label = "Notify me by",
    options = listOf(StanceCheckboxOption("email", "Email"), StanceCheckboxOption("sms", "Text message")),
    selected = channels,
    onSelectedChange = { channels = it },
    selectAll = true,
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Select all is a tri state checkbox that reads mixed when some are chosen.
Errors are announced.

android.name: StanceCodeBlock
android.summary: Monospaced source code in a bordered block that scrolls sideways, with line numbers and copy.
android.example:
StanceCodeBlock(
    code = "dependencies {\n    implementation(libs.stance.compose)\n}",
    title = "build.gradle.kts",
    showLineNumbers = true,
)
accessibility: Line numbers are hidden from screen readers.
Code stays left to right in right to left layouts.

android.name: StanceCopyButton
android.summary: Copies text to the clipboard, then confirms with a check, a haptic tick and a spoken Copied.
android.example: StanceCopyButton(text = "https://sign.binds.si/t/nda", label = "Copy link", showLabel = true)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The confirmation is a polite live region.

android.name: StanceCombobox
android.summary: A text field that narrows a list of options as you type, then fills in the chosen one.
android.example:
var team by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
StanceCombobox(label = "Team", options = teams, selected = team, onSelect = { team = it }, placeholder = "Type to search")
accessibility: The keyboard stays open while the list filters.
An empty result is announced.

android.name: StanceMultiSelect
android.summary: Picks several values from a searchable menu and shows each one as a removable chip.
android.example:
var chosen by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf("sales", "legal")) }
StanceMultiSelect(label = "Teams", options = teams, selected = chosen, onSelectedChange = { chosen = it })
accessibility: Options are checkboxes announced with their state.
Each chip has a named remove action.

android.name: stanceContextMenu
android.summary: A modifier that opens a menu of actions at the point where an element is long pressed.
accessibility: Screen readers get a named long click action.
A long press never also clicks the element underneath.

android.name: StanceTreeView
android.summary: A lazy hierarchy of folders and items that expand and collapse, with optional selection.
android.example:
StanceTreeView(
    nodes = listOf(
        StanceTreeNode("contracts", "Contracts", listOf(StanceTreeNode("nda", "Mutual NDA.pdf"), StanceTreeNode("msa", "MSA.pdf"))),
        StanceTreeNode("readme", "Read me.txt"),
    ),
    label = "Files",
    initiallyExpanded = setOf("contracts"),
    modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSpacing.space32 + StanceSpacing.space16),
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Rows report Expanded or Collapsed and their position.
Chevrons mirror in right to left layouts.

android.name: StanceInlineEdit
android.summary: Text that becomes an editable field when tapped, with save, cancel and validation.
android.example:
var name by remember { mutableStateOf("Sales team signature") }
StanceInlineEdit(value = name, onCommit = { name = it }, label = "template name")
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The read view is one button named, for example, Edit template name.
Back cancels the edit.

android.name: StanceNotificationItem
android.summary: One notification row with title, body, time, an unread marker and swipe actions.
android.example:
var unread by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceNotificationItem(
    title = "Amara signed the NDA",
    body = "All parties have signed. The final copy is ready.",
    time = "5 min ago",
    unread = unread,
    onMarkRead = { unread = false },
)
accessibility: Unread is spoken, not shown by the dot alone.
Mark as read and swipe actions are also custom actions.

android.name: StanceNumberField
android.summary: A numeric input with step buttons, bounds and number formatting for the current locale.
android.example:
var seats by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(5.0) }
StanceNumberField(value = seats, onValueChange = { seats = it }, label = "Seats", min = 1.0, max = 50.0)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Step buttons are named and disabled at the bounds.
Arrow keys step on a hardware keyboard.

android.name: StancePagination
android.summary: Previous and next controls with a page summary, plus numbered page buttons on wide windows.
android.example:
var page by remember { mutableIntStateOf(1) }
StancePagination(page = page, pageCount = 12, onPageChange = { page = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The page summary is a polite live region.
Arrows mirror in right to left layouts.

android.name: StancePinField
android.summary: Boxes for a one time code or PIN that accept typing, paste and SMS code autofill.
android.example:
var code by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
StancePinField(value = code, onValueChange = { code = it }, onComplete = { /* verify the code */ })
accessibility: One field for screen readers, with progress such as 2 of 6 entered.
A masked field is announced as a password.

android.name: StancePopover
android.summary: A small floating panel with a caret that points at the control that opened it.
accessibility: Announced as a pane named by its title.
Dismisses on back and outside taps.

android.name: StanceRichText
android.summary: Renders Markdown with Stance type styles, including headings, lists, quotes and links.
android.example:
StanceRichText("## Rollout
Signatures deploy **tonight**. Read the [guide](https://www.stanceui.com).

- Sales
- Legal")
accessibility: Headings are marked as headings.
Links are real link annotations that TalkBack can open.

android.name: StanceSortableList
android.summary: A list reordered by dragging a handle, with move up and move down as accessible actions.
accessibility: Move up and Move down are custom actions on every row.
The new position is announced after a move.

android.name: StanceThemeSwitcher
android.summary: A segmented control for choosing system, light, dark or high contrast appearance.
android.example:
var appearance by rememberStanceAppearance()
StanceThemeSwitcher(appearance = appearance, onAppearanceChange = { appearance = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Announced as a group with the chosen appearance selected.

android.name: StanceToolbar
android.summary: A raised pill of related icon actions, such as text formatting, that floats over content.
accessibility: Read as one group named by its label.
Scrolls when the actions do not fit.
